support_rule: strictly positive registered planar convex-hull intersection; no IoU threshold

decision_gate.rank_only_incremental_opportunity: Rank-only must emit at least one false positive across the frozen scenarios.
decision_gate.support_true_matches: All frozen truth correspondences across all scenarios.
decision_gate.zero_assignment: Exact unmatched reference and query sets in every frozen scenario.
decision_gate.no_true_match_regression: Extent-supported true positives must be at least rank-only true positives.
decision_gate.single_replay: One replay on the frozen physical-target-disjoint same-class cohort; do not tune or rerun after outcome.

claim_boundary: A pass is same-provider, same-scan-family, physical-target-disjoint real-geometry Development evidence that parameter-free positive registered planar extent overlap adds decision-changing absolute support over rank-only surface matching for truth-proposed stable indoor doorframes under bounded missing/extra rosters. Provider labels, complete surfaces, and the rigid transform are privileged. Positive projected overlap is spatial support, not portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, provider-independent confirmation, user benefit, or mobility safety.
